g.text: Before the scan, because the scan is what the
answer is needed for. Costs about a second
even on a fifteen-hour book, against the full
decode feeding both. The silence scan and
the voice-activity pre-pass read the same PCM
as it goes past, rather than decoding the book
stream the same PCM to Silero VAD

With silence probing off it is
"everything above 0": that is exactly what the

Derived from the scan's own two signals and
nothing else, so it costs no audio work - and
merged regions. It yields how far back this
book's music can reach, which two later passes
in different phases both ask for.
The material every later "why there?" question
comes back to, and it cannot be recovered
afterwards without re-decoding the whole file.
A separate sink, because the counts run to
thousands of silences and tens of thousands
of speech segments on a full book.
